texts: A foil sticker from five typed letters: 640 pixels, 48 stamps, 16 contour cases and a shader peel

A foil sticker from five typed letters, with no image or model file behind it: a 640 pixel canvas, 48 stamps for the die-cut margin, 16 marching squares cases, a Delaunay mesh and a shader peel. The walkthrough follows one word from keystroke to curl, with the code.

issues.quote: its Vertex AI integration lets agents leverage Gemini models alongside the three.ws identity layer
issues.problem: "leverage" is filler register flagged by the voice gate; the sentence also reads as marketing copy inside an otherwise exact partners section.
issues.fix: Replace with: "its Vertex AI integration lets agents use Gemini models alongside the three.ws identity layer."

issues.quote: A word of 16 characters, the most the text box accepts, is scaled to fit with the same rule.
issues.problem: Minor: the sentence sits in the font-sizing paragraph before the 16-character limit is introduced in the next paragraph, so the limit appears before its justification.
issues.fix: Swap the order so the input limit is stated first: "The text box trims the input and cuts it at 16 characters. A word of that full 16 is scaled to fit with the same sizing rule."

altText: A die-cut holographic foil sticker of three slanted bars floating on black, its backing shading from violet to teal, its top corner curling up where it peels, rendered live on the three.ws Holo Sticker page

editor.summary: Every number, mechanism and partner designation in this Article verifies against the code or the live pages, the structure hits the Article standard (one run followed end to end, real code, four images, partners, Try it), and the cover matches its alt text. One fix needed: replace "leverage" in the Google Cloud partner line, per the register gate; a small reorder of the 16-character limit sentence is optional polish.
